items.title: Residential Construction
items.statusNote: We're starting with repairs, accessibility upgrades and small-to-medium renovations. Additions, accessory dwelling units and custom homes will follow as our crews and capacity grow.
items.summary: Renovations, additions and home improvements planned carefully and delivered with clear pricing, steady communication and respect for the home you live in.
items.audience: Homeowners, families and people planning to age in place.
includes: Accessibility and aging-in-place upgrades: ramps, rails, entrances and bathrooms
Kitchens, bathrooms and living spaces adapted for real life
items.imageAlt: A woman contractor in a Level Headed cap reviews renovation plans at a kitchen counter with an older homeowner.

items.title: Commercial & Institutional
items.statusNote: We take on smaller commercial and institutional projects that match our current crew and insurance. Ask us about scope and we'll tell you honestly whether it's a fit.
items.summary: Renovations, facility improvements and specialty projects for organizations that need reliable work done with minimal disruption.
items.audience: Small businesses, nonprofits, community organizations and institutions.
items.imageAlt: A woman in a Level Headed hoodie takes notes on a clipboard while assessing the exterior of a building.

items.title: Social & Co-operative Housing
items.summary: Dependable unit turnovers and property work for housing providers, so homes get back to the people who need them, sooner.
items.audience: Housing co-operatives, nonprofit and social housing providers, and property managers.
includes: Patching, painting, flooring, fixtures and safety fixes
items.imageAlt: A woman wearing safety glasses and work gloves uses a cordless drill on exterior siding.
items.ctaLabel: Talk to us about your portfolio

items.title: Panelized Construction
items.statusNote: We deliver panelized work through fabrication and installation partnerships. We do not own or operate a panel manufacturing facility.
items.summary: Panelized building solutions for our own projects and for qualified partners, bringing more predictability, speed and repeatability to housing delivery.
items.audience: Housing providers, developers, municipalities and general contractors.
includes: Panelized building systems for additions, ADUs and housing
Construction efficiency and housing delivery opportunities
items.imageAlt: A woman in a Level Headed cap and hoodie stands in front of timber framing on a construction site.

items.title: Construction Management
items.summary: Organized projects with a clear scope, a real budget and one accountable lead, so owners always know what's happening and why.
items.audience: Property owners, organizations and housing providers.

items.title: Construction Consulting
items.summary: Practical advice from people who have run the work, to help you make better decisions before and during a project.
items.audience: Owners, nonprofits, housing providers and construction businesses.

items.title: Maintenance & Property Improvements
items.summary: Repairs and maintenance that keep homes and buildings safe, functional and looking their best, before small problems become big ones.
items.audience: Homeowners, property managers and housing providers.
items.imageAlt: A woman wearing safety glasses installs a stainless-steel grab bar in a tiled shower.

items.title: Housing & Community Development
items.statusNote: These are longer-term goals that we will pursue with partners when the work, people and financing support them.
items.summary: Future projects that expand attainable housing: accessory units, shared and intentional living, and partner-led housing delivery.
items.audience: Municipalities, housing partners, landowners and community organizations.
